notablePrerequisites: Lands you control except Conqueror's Foothold can tap to produce at least {8}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate any number of lands you control except Conqueror's Foothold by tapping them, adding at least {8}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Conqueror's Foothold's fourth ability by paying {6} and tapping it, returning Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
